faq.q: Can one product photo make both a vertical clip and a listing image?
faq.a: Yes. Use a tall 9:16 video at 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds for a routine or a short demo. The same photo can also make a still. A 6-second clip is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 is 60, and 30 is 120. A still image is 24 credits.

faq.q: Can a product photo become a clip of someone using it?
faq.a: Yes. Use a clear photo of the whole item, or paste a product link, and describe the AI actor and the room. You can pick from 53 AI actors.

faq.q: Will the shade or the package change?
faq.a: The result follows your photo. Fine print and small caps stay closer when the upload is sharp. If a detail moves, make another version. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Can I choose the look of the AI actor?
faq.a: Yes. Describe age range and features in plain words. The AI actor is generated for that ad, and you can ask again if the look is off.

faq.q: What photo should I use for a beauty ad?
faq.a: Show the whole product, front side up, in even light. The shape, the shade, and the cap all need to be clear before you start.

faq.q: How do I keep the shade true?
faq.a: Shoot in soft daylight, not under a warm lamp, and name the shade in plain words so the file can be checked against the sample.

faq.q: Can I post these clips as paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark, and you can use it in paid ads. What you say about the product has to match what you ship.

faq.q: How is this different from hiring a creator?
faq.a: You pick an AI actor and pay the credits shown before the job, not a creator fee. Post the clip once the product still matches the sample.

faq.q: Can the ad include a spoken voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. The clip can include a spoken line and captions, and you can publish it to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.
